name: Web Design Guidelines
summary: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance: accessibility, performance and UX rules in the terse file:line format. OpenAR-adapted carry of the vercel-labs skill: the rules are vendored from vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines at a pinned commit instead of fetched from its mutable main branch at review time; the recorded differences are in PROVENANCE.md inside the skill.

summaryI18n.zh-CN: 按 Web Interface Guidelines 审查 UI 代码：无障碍、性能与体验规则，以 file:line 简报输出。vercel-labs 技能的 OpenAR 适配携带：规则自 vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines 钉住 commit 本地携带，替代审阅时从可变 main 分支拉取；差异记录在技能内 PROVENANCE.md。

permissionsNote: allowed-tools declarations inside SKILL.md are upstream claims, not host approvals; OpenAR enforces its own permission gates.
